t: University-level classroom modules for teaching robot autonomy with slides, videos, and activities.
steps: Open the Duckietown educational resources page and browse the module list.
Pick one module, such as computer vision, and read its slides.
Ask IT to help with the laptop setup for hands-on activities.
Decide whether to create the optional hub account.
Ask the vendor about pricing before ordering a Duckiebot DB21.
Add physical activities after the simulation work succeeds.
